FN-A1A1SS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 155
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 155 as introduced allows the Board of Medical Examiners to issue permits to a
bridge year graduate physician to practice medicine under the supervision of a licensed
physician. This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Board by an estimated
maximum of $2,500 for the first year, and would decrease substantially thereafter, to establish a
standing working group to draft qualifications and rules for this permit. However, the increased
obligations would be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of application and renewal
permit fees in amounts established by the board.

estimated maximum of $2,500 for the first year, and decreasing substantially thereafter, to
establish a standing working group to draft qualifications and rules for this permit. However, the
increased obligations would be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of application and
